title: Ong Ling Ling buys S$302K of Metro Holdings Ltd shares
body: Ong Ling Ling bought 845,000 shares of Metro Holdings Ltd in a market transaction at S$0.3573 per share, for a total of S$301,918. Total interest rises from 238,039,198 shares (28.75%) to 238,884,198 shares (28.85%).
remarks_text: In this notification, the shareholding percentage immediately before and after change is based on 828,035,874 issued shares (excluding treasury shares).

title: BlackRock, Inc's deemed interest in CapitaLand Ascendas REIT falls after S$2.2M share sale
body: BlackRock, Inc's deemed interest in CapitaLand Ascendas REIT fell after a party linked to the holder sold 1,043,200 shares in a market transaction at S$2.0868 per share, for a total of S$2,176,949. title: Jin Xiao Qun reports change in interest in Nanofilm Technologies International Ltd after share buyback
body: Jin Xiao Qun reported a change in interest in Nanofilm Technologies International Ltd after the company bought back shares. The transaction involved 200,000 shares. The number of shares held is unchanged at 38,882,893.
deemed_interest_text: (1) Mdm Jin Xiao Qun holds more than 20% of the shares of Harrymore International Limited ("Harrymore"). Accordingly, for the purposes of Section 4 of the Securities and Futures Act 2001 of Singapore ("SFA"), Mdm Jin Xiao Qun is treated as having an interest in the 28,192,518 Shares held by Harrymore. (2) Mdm Jin Xiao Qun holds 50% of the total issued shares in Neufront Investment Private Limited ("Neufront"). Accordingly, for the purposes of Section 4 of the SFA, Mdm Jin Xiao Qun is deemed to have an interest in the 500,000 Shares held by Neufront.
remarks_text: The percentage of shareholdings immediately before the transaction are calculated based on the Company's total issued shares of 648,159,688 (excluding treasury shares) as at 26 November 2026. The percentage of shareholdings immediately after the transaction are calculated based on the Company's total issued shares of 647,959,688 (excluding treasury shares) as at 26 November 2026. In this Notice, figures are rounded to the nearest 0.001%.
change_reason: the Company's share buy back of 200,000 shares by way of market acquisition

title: HSBC International Trustee Limited ceases to be substantial shareholder of Hafary Holdings Ltd
body: HSBC International Trustee Limited's deemed interest in Hafary Holdings Ltd fell after Hap Seng Investment Holdings Pte. Ltd sold 218,790,000 shares at S$0.64 per share, for a total of S$140,025,600. No shares are held directly. Total interest falls from 218,790,000 shares (50.82%) to 0 shares (0.00%). With this, the holder ceases to be a substantial shareholder of Hafary Holdings Ltd.
deemed_interest_text: N/A - This is a cessation of interests.
relationship_text: Hap Seng Investment Holdings Pte. Ltd. (“HSIH”) which directly holds the listed company is wholly owned by Hap Seng Consolidated Berhad (“HSCB”). Gek Poh (Holdings) Sdn. Bhd. owns 54.63% of HSCB, and Magic Principle Assets Limited owns 44% of Gek Poh (Holdings) Sdn. Bhd. HSBC International Trustee Limited ("HKIT") acts as a trustee for Magic Principle Assets Limited. HKIT is wholly owned by HSBC International Trustee (Holdings) Pte. Limited ("HTHL"), which is, in turn, wholly owned by The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited ("HBAP"). HBAP is wholly owned by HSBC Asia Holdings Limited ("HAHO"), which is, in turn, wholly owned by HSBC Holdings plc ("HGHQ"). On 23 November 2026, HSIH completed the sale of its entire shareholding in Hafary Holdings Limited (“Hafary Holdings”) to 23 Capital Pte. Ltd. Following completion of the transaction, HKIT ceased to hold any interest in Hafary Holdings.
remarks_text: The shareholding percentages in this form are computed based on a total of 430,550,000 issued ordinary shares (excluding treasury shares) of Hafary Holdings Limited.
change_reason: the sale of HSIH's entire shareholding in Hafary Holdings to 23 Capital Pte. Ltd
acting_party: Hap Seng Investment Holdings Pte. Ltd
